scripts.wasm: cd crates/typeset-wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --release
scripts.test: cargo test -p typeset-core && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:ts: for f in document session editor-transactions selection search scroll links parse coalesce layout math-lifecycle math-parse math-transform math-svg math-refs; do npx esbuild test/$f.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.test-$f.mjs --log-level=error && node node_modules/.test-$f.mjs || exit 1; done
